name: claude-autocommit
description: Generate Conventional Commit messages with a single gitmoji from your staged changes, using your existing Claude subscription.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Claude Auto Commit runs the Claude Code CLI against your repository.

enumDescriptions: Recommended balance of quality and speed.
Fastest and cheapest; good for small diffs.
claudeAutoCommit.model.markdownDescription: Claude model used to write the commit message. Usage is billed to the Claude account you are signed into with the Claude Code CLI.

claudeAutoCommit.emojiPosition.markdownDescription: Where the single type emoji is placed in the subject line.

claudeAutoCommit.includeScope.markdownDescription: Include a `(scope)` derived from the staged paths, e.g. `feat(auth):`.

claudeAutoCommit.includeBody.markdownDescription: Write a body under the subject explaining what changed and why.

enumDescriptions: Body lines rendered as wrapped paragraphs.
claudeAutoCommit.bodyStyle.markdownDescription: How the commit body is formatted.

claudeAutoCommit.maxSubjectLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of the subject line, including the emoji and type prefix.

claudeAutoCommit.detectBreakingChanges.markdownDescription: Allow Claude to mark breaking changes with `!` after the type and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.

claudeAutoCommit.types.markdownDescription: Commit types Claude is allowed to choose from. Every type needs an emoji in `#claudeAutoCommit.emojiMap#`.

claudeAutoCommit.emojiMap.markdownDescription: Override the emoji for a commit type, e.g. `{ "feat": "🚀" }`. Merged over the built-in gitmoji defaults.

claudeAutoCommit.customInstructions.markdownDescription: Extra rules appended to the prompt, e.g. `Always reference the Jira ticket from the branch name.`

claudeAutoCommit.language.markdownDescription: Natural language the commit message is written in.

claudeAutoCommit.maxDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Size budget for the staged diff sent to Claude. Larger diffs are trimmed per file and you are told when that happens.

claudeAutoCommit.claudePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to discover it on `PATH` and in the usual install locations.

claudeAutoCommit.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long to wait for Claude before giving up.

enumDescriptions: Overwrite whatever is in the commit input box.
Do nothing if the commit input box already has text.
claudeAutoCommit.appendMode.markdownDescription: What to do when the Source Control input box is not empty.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs --production
